messages.subject: [Phenopix-developers] Hello, NDVI-guy here
messages.body_plain:
Hello Edoardo, Mirco and Gianluca,

Maybe the first two of you remember me from the skype we had together 
with Enrico Tomelleri. I was doing a two months internship at EURAC.

I just want to say hello. Therefore I joined this r-forge email list. I 
hope this is fine for you? How are things going?

Did Enrico send you my documentation + code for what I was dong with 
NDVI extraction?
Otherwise I'll send you a copy.

Best, from W?rzburg
Jeroen
